lessons.title: Introduction to Baybayin
lessons.description: Learn the basics of Baybayin script, its history, and fundamental characters. Perfect for beginners starting their Baybayin journey.

lessons.title: Baybayin Vowels and Consonants
lessons.description: Master the vowel and consonant characters in Baybayin. Understand how they combine to form syllables and words.

lessons.title: Writing Your Name in Baybayin
lessons.description: A practical guide to writing your name and common words in Baybayin. Includes step-by-step instructions and examples.

lessons.title: Advanced Baybayin Techniques
lessons.description: Explore advanced writing techniques, ligatures, and traditional Baybayin styles. For those ready to deepen their practice.

lessons.title: Baybayin Calligraphy Basics
lessons.description: Discover the art of Baybayin calligraphy. Learn proper stroke techniques, pen handling, and basic decorative elements.

lessons.title: Common Phrases in Baybayin
lessons.description: Learn to write and read everyday phrases in Baybayin. Perfect for practical application and daily practice.

lessons.title: Baybayin in Modern Context
lessons.description: Explore how Baybayin is used in contemporary settings, from art to digital media and cultural preservation.

lessons.title: Baybayin Typography
lessons.description: Study different Baybayin typefaces and learn how to create your own digital Baybayin fonts.

lessons.title: Baybayin Art Projects
lessons.description: Creative projects combining Baybayin with various art forms. Perfect for artists and creative enthusiasts.

lessons.title: Baybayin for Educators
lessons.description: Specialized guide for teachers and educators on how to effectively teach Baybayin to students of all ages.
